entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/results/skills/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **誓约遗命律（P155）**：死床命令以"安全"为质——PG19750 L304–307："See to it that none thwart me after I am dead. It stands upon your safety."遗命是与死者的活合同：守誓者品格=闹鬼开关。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/results/skills/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **禁言令缓刑律（P111）**：禁令以数十年为引信；日常幸福抹平恐怖→无意闲话触禁→对质兑现→关系改变刑罚。PG1210 卡 F7（雪女）：L1743–1746 禁令全文→L1835–1842 对质（"It was I—I—I! Yuki it was!... But for those children asleep there, I would kill you this moment!"）→L1844–1847 化雾离宅。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/results/skills/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **伪誓杠杆律（PG1710·P47）**：诱使对方在圣物前立誓"无事"，再以誓言为永久禁声刑具——受害者的虔诚被转化为禁声装置；引信的**武器化反向**。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/results/skills/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **执念定向律**：临终最后执念即鬼之全部能力——PG1210 L810–823（断头外交：武士以"try to bite the stepping-stone"分心，断头滚落咬石，"that purpose he was able to accomplish, but nothing else... So you need not feel any further anxiety"L853–855；"Nothing at all happened."L857）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/results/skills/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **诅咒赠礼律（P156）**：把受赠人贪求之物遗赠之即埋咒——PG19750 L292–295："My scarlet cloak with the silver, I will to that poor fool your wife. She longed for it so bitterly, I may not even now deny her."欲望的满足即毒药的分发；同一遗产中洁份（Asdis）与咒份（Aud）并存，人格决定物权性质。

entries.text: - **失效模式**：自然解释太弱（读者不信）或太强（恐惧蒸发，PG3268·P1 边界注）；硬超自然无自洽规则则沦为任意。

entries.text: 3. **减杀/退出条件**——如有赦免、减杀或不可逆代价须明确；不是每个诅咒都可以赦免（母职缓刑：PG1210 卡 P111，雪女禁言令兑现但"母职缓刑"化雾离宅）。

entries.text: - **誓约遗命律（P155）**：死床命令以"安全"为质——PG19750 L304–307："See to it that none thwart me after I am dead. It stands upon your safety."遗命是与死者的活合同：守誓者品格=闹鬼开关。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent-b-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **禁言令缓刑律（P111）**：禁令以数十年为引信；日常幸福抹平恐怖→无意闲话触禁→对质兑现→关系改变刑罚。PG1210 卡 F7（雪女）：L1743–1746 禁令全文→L1835–1842 对质（"It was I—I—I! Yuki it was!... But for those children asleep there, I would kill you this moment!"）→L1844–1847 化雾离宅。

entries.text: - **伪誓杠杆律（PG1710·P47）**：诱使对方在圣物前立誓"无事"，再以誓言为永久禁声刑具——受害者的虔诚被转化为禁声装置；引信的**武器化反向**。

entries.text: - **执念定向律**：临终最后执念即鬼之全部能力——PG1210 L810–823（断头外交：武士以"try to bite the stepping-stone"分心，断头滚落咬石，"that purpose he was able to accomplish, but nothing else... So you need not feel any further anxiety"L853–855；"Nothing at all happened."L857）。

entries.text: - **诅咒赠礼律（P156）**：把受赠人贪求之物遗赠之即埋咒——PG19750 L292–295："My scarlet cloak with the silver, I will to that poor fool your wife. She longed for it so bitterly, I may not even now deny her."欲望的满足即毒药的分发；同一遗产中洁份（Asdis）与咒份（Aud）并存，人格决定物权性质。

entries.text: - 幻宅揭底律（P109）：贵人宅=墓群——PG1210 L390–400：雨夜循声寻至墓地，"behind him, and about him, and everywhere above the tombs, the fires of the dead were burning, like candles"；僧断语 L437–440："All that you have been imagining was illusion—except the calling of the dead."

entries.text: - 双重空间残影：PG10659 L1260–1261——"That school building has long been in ruins," said the man at his side presently；PG10659 L1263–1265——"the simulacra of certain ghastly events that took place under that roof in past days still continue. And the 'shells' of the chief participants still enact there the dreadful deeds that led to its final destruction"——残影复演的是旧日本身，非自由行动的鬼魂。

entries.text: - 门=阈限=最小物证：PG45964 卡 P81（门=墓碑）；PG1190·P44（门之状态律：习惯绝不应关之门被关="另一行动者"之充分证据——以习惯违反而非异象证明在场）。

entries.text: - 隐门伪装修复律（P149）：罪之空间的建筑隐匿全套——PG11610 L638–643："a keyhole stopped with wood, and planed across as smooth as the rest, and the joining of the door all stopped wi' putty the colour o' yak"（前掩空橱）。

entries.text: - **失效模式**：空间测绘前后不一致即廉价翻转——空间即伏笔（PG3268·P2：建筑奇观后置兑现为情节机关，"修缮清单式的空间清单"）。

entries.text: - 门后之声审判律（P134）：以声音隔门验身份——PG43 L1325–1326："Was that my master's voice?"（Poole 验声）+L1331–1332 资历担保（"Have I been twenty years in this man's house, to be deceived about his voice?"）；踱步声 L1499–1523；"Once I heard it weeping!... like a woman or a lost soul"（L1511–1517）；破门时"Utterson, for God's sake, have mercy!"——"that's not Jekyll's voice—it's Hyde's!"（L1531–1534）。

entries.text: - 显形与暴力是可选峰值而非必要条件——反证族：PG14168·P1（三通道不显形，每通道须开篇伏笔+终局回收）；PG1190·P44（一扇门承载整篇）；PG1710（全篇无鬼：伪誓+一堵墙+二十日沉默）；PG43 破门反高潮；PG10659 印象残存；PG1210 R80。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent-b-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **P**：中短篇显形 ≤1 次；长篇每卷 ≤1 次全程显形；显形前的憋蓄长度与显形时长成正比；每次显形须回收一个开篇伏笔（PG10624·P7 伏笔即解药律的恐怖面）。

entries.text: - 考古型：PG10002·P16（手稿考古框架律：发现者-编者注-残损文本三位一体，损毁处即留白、终笔中断即死亡时刻；外框证人负责"证实"里层不可证之事）；轻量反讽形态见 PG5083·P30（填料残稿律：损毁原因可笑）、P31（稿内伪造律：异手异墨）。

Utterson ALONE, and in case of his predecease _to be destroyed unread_"内含"not to be opened till the death or disappearance of Dr. Henry Jekyll"）；L1660–1669 临终信指向两份自述。**"disappearance"一词在文书中三度回响**（L1108–1114 Utterson 自指出）。

entries.text: - 遗书自危律（P144）：写作行为本身处于另一自我威胁下——PG43 L2536–2538："Should the throes of change take me in the act of writing it, Hyde will tear it in pieces"；L2548–2551（"this is my true hour of death... I bring the life of that unhappy Henry Jekyll to an end."）。

entries.text: - **好奇交易抉择律（P137）**：揭底前给见证人退出机会——PG43 L1911–1921："Will you be wise? will you be guided?... or has the greed of curiosity too much command of you? Think before you answer... your sight shall be blasted by a prodigy to stagger the unbelief of Satan."（把读者的好奇心具身化为角色的选择）。

entries.text: - **见证致死律（P136）**：目击核心事件者以死支付——PG43 L1047–1048（"I have had a shock... It is a question of weeks"）+L1035（"He had his death-warrant written legibly upon his face"）+L1946–1952（"my life is shaken to its roots; sleep has left me... and yet I shall die incredulous."——至死不信）。

entries.text: - **秘密永藏律（P114）**：执念物当面处置、内容永不示人——PG1210 L1684–1696："Shall I burn it for you?"（影颔首微笑而灭）→"The letter was burned... the secret died with him."；R85（双重守密节制）：即使内文档揭底章，最深的恐怖（Hyde 纵欲清单）也从未写出，只被反应侧写。

entries.text: - **收束调性对账**：无伤亡→轻收（公文喜剧：PG10659 L5095–5127 遗帽+孟买电报"Bombay. Just slipped out again. All safe. Have blocked entrances."+Cook 待领件）；有伤亡→肃穆（PG10659 R76 伤亡边界：Case II 枪击致永久伤痕→收尾转祷告声景 L4306–4314）。

entries.text: - 文献驱魔与物证庭审律（P113）：志怪文献中的处置法可实操+怪物特征=庭证——PG1210 L1415–1423（僧引《Sōshinki》移身断首法："if one find the body of a Rokuro-Kubi without its head, and remove the body to another place, the head will never be able to join itself again"）；世俗法庭验首 L1529–1536（"several strange red characters"于颈后+断口"smooth as the line at which a falling leaf detaches itself from the stem"）+引《Nan-hō-ï-butsu-shi》鬼谱（L1538–1543）。

entries.text: - 诊断装置学（P107，单族 Blackwood）：独处面容论——PG10659 L4429–4434："A man sitting alone wears a psychic expression; and this expression is the man himself. It disappears the moment another person joins him."（钉死椅/镇静气按钮/窥孔——诊室改造成行为实验场；被观察者反贴窥孔对视=能力反转惊悚点）。**单族来源，作可选样式不作通则。**

entries.text: - **P**：记录作品的自然/超自然证据契约；可改轨或双轨并置，但需新证据或叙述者认知转变，不能无交代切换。科学轨的不可知核可用"杂质偶然律"（PG43 L2527–2529："my first supply was impure, and that it was that unknown impurity which lent efficacy to the draught"——首批药物的未知杂质才是有效成分，仿制皆废）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **失效模式**：自然解释太弱（读者不信）或太强（恐惧蒸发，PG3268·P1 边界注）；硬超自然无自洽规则则沦为任意。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: 3. **减杀/退出条件**——如有赦免、减杀或不可逆代价须明确；不是每个诅咒都可以赦免（母职缓刑：PG1210 卡 P111，雪女禁言令兑现但"母职缓刑"化雾离宅）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **誓约遗命律（P155）**：死床命令以"安全"为质——PG19750 L304–307："See to it that none thwart me after I am dead. It stands upon your safety."遗命是与死者的活合同：守誓者品格=闹鬼开关。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **禁言令缓刑律（P111）**：禁令以数十年为引信；日常幸福抹平恐怖→无意闲话触禁→对质兑现→关系改变刑罚。PG1210 卡 F7（雪女）：L1743–1746 禁令全文→L1835–1842 对质（"It was I—I—I! Yuki it was!... But for those children asleep there, I would kill you this moment!"）→L1844–1847 化雾离宅。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **伪誓杠杆律（PG1710·P47）**：诱使对方在圣物前立誓"无事"，再以誓言为永久禁声刑具——受害者的虔诚被转化为禁声装置；引信的**武器化反向**。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **执念定向律**：临终最后执念即鬼之全部能力——PG1210 L810–823（断头外交：武士以"try to bite the stepping-stone"分心，断头滚落咬石，"that purpose he was able to accomplish, but nothing else... So you need not feel any further anxiety"L853–855；"Nothing at all happened."L857）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **诅咒赠礼律（P156）**：把受赠人贪求之物遗赠之即埋咒——PG19750 L292–295："My scarlet cloak with the silver, I will to that poor fool your wife. She longed for it so bitterly, I may not even now deny her."欲望的满足即毒药的分发；同一遗产中洁份（Asdis）与咒份（Aud）并存，人格决定物权性质。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **展示条款律（P157）**：物设用法条款并死后执行——PG19750 L697–698："The things are for no use but to be shown," it said. "Aud, Aud, have you shown them once?  No, not once!"秘藏即违约，鬼声引述原条款追责。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **预兆双现律（P79）**：固定句梦→现实原样重演（PG72421 卡 P79）；预言锚定律（PG6781·P23）：骗局以永不解释的"真预言"开场，其后一切可揭穿的戏法都挂在该锚上。

entries.text: 1. **成全其欲**（欲望病理型专用）：疏导式解咒律 P98——PG10659 L3655–3656："Is not to quench this savage force," replied Dr. Silence, "but to steer it better, and to provide other outlets"；PG10659 L3659–3661："The best and quickest cure of all," he went on, speaking very gently and with a hand upon the clergyman's arm, "is to lead it towards its object"；攻击行为全翻案为寻访失败（L4127–4131："he went instinctively and in all innocence to seek her out--with the result... that she woke and was terrified"）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: 2. **应答其礼**（受食止祟）：裸形置食现形律 P159——PG19750 L417–425："a big, buxom woman, high in flesh and naked as she was born"（死妇裸体置食）；PG19750 L436："The dead wife reproves me"（主人自省）；PG19750 L442："it would have been the last as well, if men had been more wise"（判词）（**应答得当可止祟**——闹鬼的可避免性明示）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: 3. **完成其仪**（情执宇宙专用）：仪式完成式解法（PG1210 卡 H2）——超度（Jikininki Ségaki 法事 L1192–1200：言毕人庵俱灭唯余古墓）、代死（Jiu-roku-zakura L2203–2214 切腹入树"because I am going to die in your stead"）、践约（O-Tei 再世婚约：书约+佛坛 L699–704）、焚信（A Dead Secret：衬纸情书当面焚，L1684–1696）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **对称律**：解咒动作须与前文伏笔对称——PG10624 卡 P7（伏笔即解药律：终局的解钥匙须在开场以日常形态出现过）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/01-mechanics-and-curses.md
entries.text: - **when_not**：纯恶单子型（PG43 Hyde 无欲可成全——结局是自毁）；怜悯也可能被辜负（PG72421 卡 P78 的成功是唯一例——写怜悯解咒须自担"唯一例"风险）。

entries.text: 四段程式（PG79427 卡 P122 为母本，PG46363/PG18508/PG5164 同族）：

entries.text: 1. **入口**：以儿童为突破口——身份论下毒离间孝道（PG79427 L199–245："your father has a right, but she is _nobody_"→婚姻不成则子女失位论→"he divested himself of _that_ pride which is the foundation of every virtue"L256–259）。

entries.text: 配套：催眠支配阶梯（PG5164 卡 P63：定身/遥控/抹忆/招唤分层测绘）；假遗物律（PG18508 卡 P56：临终忏悔翻转物证价值，"听信临终者"成为道德陷阱）。

entries.text: - 证据：PG10659 L2322–2325——"in actual life this is often the way the dreadful climaxes move upon us, leaving the heart undisturbed almost to the last minute, and then overwhelming it with a sudden rush of horror"；L2332–2338（Joan 早餐宣布夜闻犬嚎被哄笑——失谐细节以喜剧形式入场）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - 证据：PG43 L69–93——繁华小街中"a certain sinister block of building thrust forward its gable"（"no window, nothing but a door... a blind forehead of discoloured wall"）：门面拟人先于任何事件。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **异常增幅差**：异常者以"同一外因下的对照组差"暴露——PG10659 L2203–2205：众人 naturally wilder，Sangree 独为"unnaturally wilder"（L1516–1519 野营脱面具"Now you will see me as I am"）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **when**：渐进式闹鬼长篇/中篇。**when_not**：冲击型短篇（PG1710 暴行后置）；序幕泄底型（PG35517·P9：把结局暴行提前到序幕，悬念=如何发生而非发生什么）。两路线并列可选；同一篇也可转换，但必须给叙事者认知、证据或场景功能上的转变理由。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - PG43 L224–229（Enfield）："He must be deformed somewhere; he gives a strong feeling of deformity, although I couldn't specify the point"——L133–136 Sawbones"turn sick and white with the desire to kill him"；L469–482（Utterson）："Something troglodytic... if ever I read Satan's signature upon a face"；L1831–1834（Lanyon 医学版）："the odd, subjective disturbance caused by his neighbourhood... a marked sinking of the pulse"。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - 理论支撑（勿省略）：纯恶单子论 P140——PG43 L2086–2093（Hyde 偏小之解："the evil side of my nature... was less robust and less developed"）+L2105–2107（"Edward Hyde, alone in the ranks of mankind, was pure evil"）：常人是善恶混合体故面目可读，纯恶无以名状——不可描述性是理论命题的叙事化，不是修辞懒惰。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **负向描述术（P101）**：描写不可见方向/维度只用否定式+流体比喻——PG10659 L5061–5068："He turned funnel-wise like water in a whirling vortex... He went neither forward nor backwards, neither to the right nor the left, neither up nor down. But he went. He went utterly."

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **印象残存律（P102）**：超验景象不可记忆，只余"memory of the impression"——PG10659 L4877–4880："I cannot now picture them to myself even, but can recall only the _memory of the impression_ they made upon me, the horror and devastating terror of it all."

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **全貌怪物化律（P103）**：认知升维的代价=熟物全面异化——PG10659 L4888–4890："It's seeing people and objects in their weird entirety, in their true and complete shapes, that is so distressing. It introduces me to a world of monsters"；PG10659 L4895–4897："To hear the human voice proceeding from this novel appearance which I scarcely recognise as a human body is ghastly, simply ghastly"

entries.text: - **延迟揭面三拍（P112，视觉制式）**：遮蔽→三唤→回转——PG1210 L1240–1243："Then that O-jochū turned around, and dropped her sleeve... and the man saw that she had no eyes or nose or mouth"；连环反转+灯灭黑场截断（L1265–1267："became like unto an Egg... And, simultaneously, the light went out."——不写逃生）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - **失效模式**：视觉/听觉三拍互不相通（PG1210 R80 调性边界）——延迟揭面三拍不可移植到纯听觉段落。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - 垂直地理律（PG10002·P17）：园→宅→窖→活板→渊，"日常中心之下即是深渊"；双宅镜像律（P18）：闹鬼之所另有异界复本，两地事件互为回声。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - 幻宅揭底律（P109）：贵人宅=墓群——PG1210 L390–400：雨夜循声寻至墓地，"behind him, and about him, and everywhere above the tombs, the fires of the dead were burning, like candles"；僧断语 L437–440："All that you have been imagining was illusion—except the calling of the dead."

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-02/rounds/round-p4-agent2-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-supernatural-craft/references/02-dread-and-atmosphere.md
entries.text: - 双重空间残影：PG10659 L1260–1261——"That school building has long been in ruins," said the man at his side presently；PG10659 L1263–1265——"the simulacra of certain ghastly events that took place under that roof in past days still continue. And the 'shells' of the chief participants still enact there the dreadful deeds that led to its final destruction"——残影复演的是旧日本身，非自由行动的鬼魂。

entries.text: - 门后之声审判律（P134）：以声音隔门验身份——PG43 L1325–1326："Was that my master's voice?"（Poole 验声）+L1331–1332 资历担保（"Have I been twenty years in this man's house, to be deceived about his voice?"）；踱步声 L1499–1523；"Once I heard it weeping!... like a woman or a lost soul"（L1511–1517）；破门时"Utterson, for God's sake, have mercy!"——"that's not Jekyll's voice—it's Hyde's!"（L1531–1534）。

entries.text: 2. **检查伤亡后的调性代价**——PG10659 R76 伤亡边界：Case III 公文轻收（遗帽+电报）合法，因无伤亡；Case II 有永久伤痕→收尾转祷告（L4306–4314 悲喜双声部："the eternal closeness of comedy to tragedy"——鼾声+祷告）；

entries.text: | PARTIAL 指定窗口 | 4 本 / 约 30,200 tokens（每本 5×120 行） | PG345、PG10832、PG8492、PG35587 |

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/SKILL.md
entries.text: - 不把人物做法、叙述者信念、时代偏见写成"作者明示规则"。本批次文本含 19 世纪种族/性别刻板描写（如 PG35587 的仆人口音、PG23379 的继母形象），它们是 FICTION_CASE，不是写作建议。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172《The Damned Thing》L20–31：验尸现场，烛光、尸体、八人围坐；读到 L34–35 `the dead man only was without expectation`，恐惧尚未开始，程序已成立。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG345《Dracula》L70 `All needless matters have been eliminated`；L73–75 `all the records chosen are exactly contemporary`——用"同时代记录"给整本档案体定信用规则。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668《The Tapestried Chamber》L37–42：转述者声明自己 `studiously avoided any attempt at ornament`（L41–42），把"朴素"当作可信度。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246《The Upper Berth》L139–148：故事在晚宴闲聊里被逼出来，`Brisbane was going to tell a story`（L148）；讲述是社交表演，不是忏悔。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG10832《Carnacki》L23–24：主角 `dislike of being asked even to skirt the borders of his story`，讲述节奏本身成为人物性格。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L296–297：被问睡得如何，答 `Oh, excellently well!` 却带着 `an air of embarrassment`；L342–343 私下追问 `How did you in reality rest during last night?`——否认本身就是证据。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L397–398：医生给出可核对的历史 `on the last three trips the people who have slept there actually have gone overboard`。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L275–276：陪审团用 `What asylum did this yer last witness escape from?` 消解证人；制度不信任成为恐怖的一部分。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L628–633：床铺 `the bedding was as dry as a bone`，但房间仍有海水味；叙述者明确困惑。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L309–310：裁决书写 `come to their death at the hands of a mountain lion`，紧接着 `some of us thinks, all the same, they had fits`——制度性自相矛盾。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L572–581：画像与鬼魂对上，主人由此承认 `there can remain no longer any doubt of the horrible reality`（L576–577）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23379 L701–705、L765–770：老照片确认身份；画中狗被刮掉（`Somebody's scraped off the paint where the dog used to be`，L770）——两条证据互相补足又互相拆台。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: **注意**：PG23379 结尾用 `That painted dog?` / `Not altogether`（L801、L807）保留双解，是可学的"留白"，也是可批评的"含糊"——不要把所有线索都留成悬案。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG10832 L3930：`I knew that none of the others saw what I was seeing.`——同一空间、不同可见性。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23379 L160–161：夜访者被写成 `A member of the household about whom Doctor Parris had neglected to tell her`，只有护士看见。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L466–467：当事人区分真异象与事后幻觉 `I knew the last to be deceptions of my own fancy`——视角限制也意味着自我怀疑。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L182–184：草被压出一条持续的线 `pressed it down--crushed it so that it did not rise`；L336–338：星光被遮 `all that were within a degree or two of the crest were blotted out`。实体全程不可见。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L570–576：舷窗被反扣打开，叙述者亲手拧紧；L618–619 海水味；L636 黄铜被拧弯 `till the thick metal began to bend`。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L399–404：先有 `the rustling of a silken gown, and the tapping of a pair of high-heeled shoes`（L399–400），再有 `The back of this form was turned to me`（L403–404）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG10832 L1295–1302：封印蜡断裂、门自开（`_The sealed doors were opening._`，L1297）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG35587 L55–58：无头骑士先以"缺什么"呈现 `something weird--something _wanting_!`（L55–56），才点明 `By heavens! it is the head!`（L58）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L599–600：`the shape of a man's arm, but was smooth, and wet, and icy cold`——先触后视；直到 L904–909 才给正面 `Like the body of a man long drowned, and yet it moved`（L904–905）、`the dead white eyes`（L907–908）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L418–432：先背影（L403–404），再转脸，峰值是脸：`the fixed features of a corpse`（L421–422）、`traces of the vilest and most hideous passions`（L422–423）、逼近到 `within half a yard of mine`（L431）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L205–223：攻击只给冲击与"缺口"：`it was as if he had been partly blotted out`（L221–222）——视觉被主动剥夺。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG22661 L776–777：夜间来访者已可见，却明确写"不害怕" `I felt not even for a moment the least fear`——说明视觉出现不等于恐惧，恐惧靠关系与代价。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **不适用**：宇宙恐怖/不可名状（此时视觉应始终缺席，只给比例与空缺，参考 PG23172）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG345 L11702–11703：受害者自述 `strangely enough, I did not want to hinder him`。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L443：军人 `all manhood melted from me like wax in the furnace`——勇气被写成生理融化。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG22661 L776–777：面对亡灵 `I felt not even for a moment the least fear`，恐惧被替换为迷恋。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/results/skills/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG23308 L421–422：受害者 `surprised at how easily he took his fate`——接受命运比挣扎更冷。

entries.text: - 不把人物做法、叙述者信念、时代偏见写成"作者明示规则"。本批次文本含 19 世纪种族/性别刻板描写（如 PG35587 的仆人口音、PG23379 的继母形象），它们是 FICTION_CASE，不是写作建议。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172《The Damned Thing》L20–31：验尸现场，烛光、尸体、八人围坐；读到 L34–35 `the dead man only was without expectation`，恐惧尚未开始，程序已成立。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG345《Dracula》L70 `All needless matters have been eliminated`；L73–75 `all the records chosen are exactly contemporary`——用"同时代记录"给整本档案体定信用规则。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668《The Tapestried Chamber》L37–42：转述者声明自己 `studiously avoided any attempt at ornament`（L41–42），把"朴素"当作可信度。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246《The Upper Berth》L139–148：故事在晚宴闲聊里被逼出来，`Brisbane was going to tell a story`（L148）；讲述是社交表演，不是忏悔。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG10832《Carnacki》L23–24：主角 `dislike of being asked even to skirt the borders of his story`，讲述节奏本身成为人物性格。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L296–297：被问睡得如何，答 `Oh, excellently well!` 却带着 `an air of embarrassment`；L342–343 私下追问 `How did you in reality rest during last night?`——否认本身就是证据。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L397–398：医生给出可核对的历史 `on the last three trips the people who have slept there actually have gone overboard`。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L275–276：陪审团用 `What asylum did this yer last witness escape from?` 消解证人；制度不信任成为恐怖的一部分。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L628–633：床铺 `the bedding was as dry as a bone`，但房间仍有海水味；叙述者明确困惑。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L309–310：裁决书写 `come to their death at the hands of a mountain lion`，紧接着 `some of us thinks, all the same, they had fits`——制度性自相矛盾。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L572–581：画像与鬼魂对上，主人由此承认 `there can remain no longer any doubt of the horrible reality`（L576–577）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23379 L701–705、L765–770：老照片确认身份；画中狗被刮掉（`Somebody's scraped off the paint where the dog used to be`，L770）——两条证据互相补足又互相拆台。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: **注意**：PG23379 结尾用 `That painted dog?` / `Not altogether`（L801、L807）保留双解，是可学的"留白"，也是可批评的"含糊"——不要把所有线索都留成悬案。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG10832 L3930：`I knew that none of the others saw what I was seeing.`——同一空间、不同可见性。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23379 L160–161：夜访者被写成 `A member of the household about whom Doctor Parris had neglected to tell her`，只有护士看见。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L466–467：当事人区分真异象与事后幻觉 `I knew the last to be deceptions of my own fancy`——视角限制也意味着自我怀疑。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L182–184：草被压出一条持续的线 `pressed it down--crushed it so that it did not rise`；L336–338：星光被遮 `all that were within a degree or two of the crest were blotted out`。实体全程不可见。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L570–576：舷窗被反扣打开，叙述者亲手拧紧；L618–619 海水味；L636 黄铜被拧弯 `till the thick metal began to bend`。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L399–404：先有 `the rustling of a silken gown, and the tapping of a pair of high-heeled shoes`（L399–400），再有 `The back of this form was turned to me`（L403–404）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG10832 L1295–1302：封印蜡断裂、门自开（`_The sealed doors were opening._`，L1297）。

entries.text: - PG35587 L55–58：无头骑士先以"缺什么"呈现 `something weird--something _wanting_!`（L55–56），才点明 `By heavens! it is the head!`（L58）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L599–600：`the shape of a man's arm, but was smooth, and wet, and icy cold`——先触后视；直到 L904–909 才给正面 `Like the body of a man long drowned, and yet it moved`（L904–905）、`the dead white eyes`（L907–908）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L418–432：先背影（L403–404），再转脸，峰值是脸：`the fixed features of a corpse`（L421–422）、`traces of the vilest and most hideous passions`（L422–423）、逼近到 `within half a yard of mine`（L431）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L205–223：攻击只给冲击与"缺口"：`it was as if he had been partly blotted out`（L221–222）——视觉被主动剥夺。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-01-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md

entries.text: - PG23172 L129–130：验尸房里的冷笑话，叙述者解释 `Against a sombre background humor shows high lights`。

entries.text: - PG23308 L250–251：反派做早餐时说 `Nothing like a good old-fashioned peasant's breakfast`——日常感反衬仪式。

entries.text: - PG10832 L87–88：老管家带着 `mournful pride` 说 `There isn't many ghosts like ours, sir`——人物的自豪本身荒诞。

entries.text: - 不把人物做法、叙述者信念、时代偏见写成"作者明示规则"。本批次文本含 19 世纪种族/性别刻板描写（如 PG35587 的仆人口音、PG23379 的继母形象），它们是 FICTION_CASE，不是写作建议。

entries.text: - PG23172《The Damned Thing》L20–31：验尸现场，烛光、尸体、八人围坐；读到 L34–35 `the dead man only was without expectation`，恐惧尚未开始，程序已成立。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG345《Dracula》L70 `All needless matters have been eliminated`；L73–75 `all the records chosen are exactly contemporary`——用"同时代记录"给整本档案体定信用规则。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668《The Tapestried Chamber》L37–42：转述者声明自己 `studiously avoided any attempt at ornament`（L41–42），把"朴素"当作可信度。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246《The Upper Berth》L139–148：故事在晚宴闲聊里被逼出来，`Brisbane was going to tell a story`（L148）；讲述是社交表演，不是忏悔。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG10832《Carnacki》L23–24：主角 `dislike of being asked even to skirt the borders of his story`，讲述节奏本身成为人物性格。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L296–297：被问睡得如何，答 `Oh, excellently well!` 却带着 `an air of embarrassment`；L342–343 私下追问 `How did you in reality rest during last night?`——否认本身就是证据。

entries.text: - PG23172 L275–276：陪审团用 `What asylum did this yer last witness escape from?` 消解证人；制度不信任成为恐怖的一部分。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG22246 L628–633：床铺 `the bedding was as dry as a bone`，但房间仍有海水味；叙述者明确困惑。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG23172 L309–310：裁决书写 `come to their death at the hands of a mountain lion`，紧接着 `some of us thinks, all the same, they had fits`——制度性自相矛盾。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG1668 L572–581：画像与鬼魂对上，主人由此承认 `there can remain no longer any doubt of the horrible reality`（L576–577）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-02-2026-10-25/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md

I have."，先建立讲述场合与听众，再进故事。PG22661 L16-42 是第三种：66 岁神父向"brother"作事后忏悔式自述，开头就给出结论"For more than three years I remained the victim of a most singular and diabolical illusion"。

entries.text: - PG10542 L546-597 的手稿是嵌套叙事——George 朗读纸包上女性笔迹的手稿，前船乘客的经历以她本人的第一人称给出；叙述层级由"谁在读"标清，不能把内层证词算到外层叙述者头上。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - PG8694 L2262-2290 的框架是圣诞守岁轮流讲鬼故事：每个讲故事的人自带叙述权限与可信度差异（后文 L2331-2488 多数故事被当场证伪），框架本身成为证据过滤器。

entries.text: - PG25016 的 PROLOGUE（L3436-3442 起："Sorcery and sanctity…these are the only realities. Each is an ecstasy, a withdrawal from the common life"）用"哲学对谈 + 一本绿皮笔记本（女孩的第一人称手稿）"双层并置——抽象论点与具体证词互为锚点。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - 可信度前提也可以先于超自然事件声明：PG19337 L146-176 开篇反复确认"Marley was dead"，并说明这是全篇可信度的前提——"or nothing wonderful can come of the story I am going to relate"。

entries.text: **F**：PG1668 L357-368 的 General 说"what happened to me last night is of a nature so peculiar ... that I could hardly bring myself to detail it even to your lordship"，并预先担心"might place me in the light of a weak-minded, superstitious fool"；他随后给出的可核对项是具体声音（L399-401 裙声与高跟鞋声）与画像辨认（L572-574）。PG22246 L612-613 相反——叙述者主动说"I am not ashamed of it in the least: I was very badly frightened"。

entries.text: **F**：PG345 里同一夜的事件被拆成四路记录——Mina 的第一人称叙述（L11664-11705）、Arthur 的现场清点（L11608-11626）、Quincey 的目击分工（L11635-11641）、以及货运律师行的商业信函（L3873-3928）。PG22246 里"前三位住客都跳海"是医生说辞（L397-398），"其中两人被值班者看见"是船长说辞（L443-446），"我自己的肘膝瘀伤次晨仍在"是叙述者自证（L574-575）。

entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG10832 把"仪器记录"做成独立的一路证据——封条与卡片（L226-245）、连到门把的相机快门（L256-264）、收不到任何声音的麦克风测试（L1880-1899）、白天与闪光照片的对比（L5080-5086）。PG78605《THE OPERATION》里，女主人幻视到的临终场景由两路外部观察锚定：女仆从窗口"看见对面葬礼"（L1520-1537），丈夫回家时带出的乙醚气味（L2191、L2203-2205）——超感知内容被可复核的旁证托住。

entries.text: **F**：PG8492 L2247-2257 的第一人称叙述者看见"同一个人两次以同一方向经过"，随后 L2270-2281 用建筑采光自行推翻："St. Barnabé is a modern church. It is small and well lighted" → "He had come in that last time by the other side-door." 视角限制由叙述者自己执行，不是作者外加。PG22246 L817-821 则由两个人物共同声明边界——叙述者先说（L817-818）"It is impossible for any human being to get in, or for any human being to open the port."，船长随即接上（L820-821）"If we see anything now, it must be either imagination or something supernatural."

entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG10832 第五案给出"同一力量对不同观察者显现不同形象"的归属难题——房东看见"the Woman"，Carnacki 看不见（L3525-3542）；他确认"he had seen a Woman... I had seen a Child"（L3568-3571），二者被判为不同实体、不同层面（L4138-4159）。PG78605《THE COACH》则让证词与物理效果直接冲突：亡者明说"You must not forget that we are ghosts. We are not really here."（L4542），可紧接着马受惊、车翻沟、两名少女死亡（L4498-4568）——"不在场"的自述被马的反应作废。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: **H**：在 V 级样本里，"显现是真的吗"不是靠情绪强度回答，而是靠 (a) 同期第三方状态、(b) 声音内容真伪、(c) 物理可达性、(d) 事件计数 四条可核查项。PG22246 第二篇演示相反结论：同一张月下面孔最终归给一位真实邻居小姐（L1417-1421 "I told everybody I had seen a ghost; there had never been any Cairngorms in the place since the memory of man"）。新补证另给出两个延伸：显现形态可以因观察者而异（此时"谁看见什么"本身是线索，不是矛盾）；证词自称"非实体"时，物理效果仍可反驳它。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: - 若结论是误认，给出误认的社会成因（PG22246 L1487-1491：一行人夜游误入庄园，她走散后撞见他）。

entries.text: **F**：PG22246 是"痕迹先于实体"的极端样例——前四夜只有舷窗被打开（L310）、低温与海水味（L294-296）、茶房"found his berth empty, but his clothes lying about"（L450-452），直到 L897-913 才出现实体。PG22661 相反：Clarimonde 在 L89-101 受圣职礼上就以其真人形象完整出场，痕迹（L468-479 园中小脚印、L1008-1026 吮血）是后来才补的。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG10542 把"痕迹先行、实体极晚"拉到最长——主角睡醒发现脸与喉咙布满环状咬痕（L1868-1896），数章后同伴 Job 身上出现同一款"little ringed marks"（L2287），而成群的实体直到 L3411-3655 才在月光下整体现身；间隔由黏液、足迹、断菌等次级痕迹维持。PG8377《The Water Ghost of Harrowby Hall》的痕迹是"湿"：她碰过的人"simply saturated with sea-water"（L94-124），地板封沥青、涂防水层都挡不住——痕迹先于任何可见形象，且本身构成规则。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **P**：先决定"读者在第几页需要开始怀疑"，再决定痕迹与实体的先后。给每个痕迹一个真实的观察者和后续作用；若实体先出场，之后仍要能变更风险（PG22661 的变更点是"双重生活无法判定哪面是梦"，L938-941）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG22246 的顺序是**触觉 → 嗅觉 → 视觉**：L596-600 先写"as though I were plunging them into the air of a damp cellar"与"a gust of wind that smelled horribly of stagnant sea-water"，抓到"something that had the shape of a man's arm, but was smooth, and wet, and icy cold"，直到 L904-909 才给出"the dead white eyes ... its shiny hair hung in foul wet curls over its dead face"。PG22661 的顺序是**视觉 → 触觉**：L122-126 先写"they shot forth rays like arrows, which I could distinctly _see_ enter my heart"，L235-238 才写"cold as a serpent's skin ... burnt there as though branded by a glowing iron"。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG10542 提供第三种排法——**听觉的"缺席"与"时段制度"**。开篇先写彻底的寂静："Nothing moved across my vision--not even a lone bird soared up against the dull sky"（L96），恐怖落在"没有声音"而非"有怪声"；随后声音被写成有昼夜节律：白昼只有哀嚎与寂静，"as the night fell with swift gloom, the strange wailing and crying was hushed, and another sound stole out upon the land--a far, sullen growling"（L161）——咆哮严格发生在入夜之后，声音制度本身就是威胁的作息表。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **P**：只选 POV 真能感知、且能改变其下一步选择的一到两种感官；删掉只为"凑次数"出现的噪音描写。想延后视觉时优先用触觉与嗅觉（PG22246 的做法）；想让读者立即卷入时先给目光接触（PG22661 的做法）；想让威胁"有自己的作息"时，把声音按昼夜或地点写成制度（PG10542 的做法），并保持一致——台账明文标注的反例是：不可把咆哮写进白昼段落（原文 L161 起）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG22246 L928-929 的结果是"my arm was broken--the small bone of the left forearm near the wrist"，此后他只能用一只手扶起船长（L931-932），行动被物理限制改写。PG792 L1855-1856 是"exhausted by the violence of my emotions, and by my speed, I sunk down in a fit"，后果是需要第三方救援、并多出一条被他人核验的路径。PG1668 L443-446 写的是意志层面的失效："all firmness forsook me, all manhood melted from me like wax in the furnace, and I felt my hair individually bristle"。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG11438 给出反应作为"保命机制"的反向用法——帐篷外暗影压来时，叙述者跌倒昏迷，事后明写疼痛与昏迷反而救了他，"that was what saved him"（L1847）；同一卷里瑞典人给出的应对法也是"照常作息、装作无事"（L1710-1725）。强反应在这里不是代价，而是唯一有效的脱险路径。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **P**：每个强反应后面接一个具体的行为后果（不能做什么、需要谁帮忙、要多长时间恢复）。若把"失能"写成解法，必须先在规则层写清"为何失能反而安全"（PG11438 的依据是"不命名、不去想"那条规则，见 04 的 R13），否则只是巧合。不强制"一次最强视觉峰值"。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG8492 L4484-4511 用最日常的夫妻对话作缓冲（"Don't forget to clean your palette." / "do you think Hercules is hungry?"），随即在 L4518 切断："Her voice faltered. A loud humming filled the air, the windows vibrated." PG22246 L762-763 的缓冲是叙述者自我管理："I abstained from Welsh rare-bits and grog that evening"——他为了保住判断力而放弃日常享受。

entries.text: ## R22 · 指示物与不可逆窗口（NEW，PG23308 为主 + PG22661 / PG345 佐证）

entries.text: **F**：PG23308 把一条咒术写成"可被观察的指示物 + 一个时间边界"：

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: 对照 PG22661：吸血规则同样给出"量"与"时机"——她只取少量并包扎（L1070-1072 "she carefully tied a little band around my arm, afterward rubbing the wound with an unguent"），而破除方式是改变认知（掘墓验尸，L1106-1110），不是打破规则。PG345 的威胁则是条件句（L11696 "Silence! If you make a sound I shall take him and dash his brains out"），条件满足即触发。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG644 的诅咒没有仪表，它的指示物是**他人的行为变化**：Tetterby 说话前"passed his hand across his forehead"，并发觉屋里气氛有变（L1607-1612）；随后孩子们"scared and sad"地退开（L1653），老祖父被抹掉血缘记忆、反复说"He's not my son"（L2605-2618）——传染的进度由谁被改变来读数。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG11438 的指示物是**可测量的空间与痕迹**：柳丛"移近了"，叙述者实测柳与帐篷的距离（L861-876）；地面沙漏状凹坑事后变大（L1874-1882）；船底被"neatly"刮出长缝（L980-1039）。威胁的进度由测量差值读出。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: - PG10832 则把"数字即指示物"写明："it took sixty-six candles to complete the circle; and I need hardly say that every number and measurement has a significance."（L1081）

entries.text: ## R30 · 制度性压迫与"伪自由"楼梯（NEW 单源，PG53686；PG53687 为同一作品续卷；条件建议）

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG53686（Melmoth the Wanderer Vol.2）把恐惧的全部来源放在人与制度上：西班牙人被搜查囚室、裹麻布投入地牢，牢内只有十字架、头骨、一块面包与一壶水（L581-1160 块）；上级借"主教查访"之名密谋用鸦片灭口（同块）。每层逃脱都通往更深的囚笼——从修道院逃出，落入的是宗教裁判所之狱："I was a prisoner in the Inquisition."（L3855-3856）；逃亡本身就是上级纵容的圈套（L3481-4060 块）。Vol.3（PG53687）开头延续同一条逃亡线（L1-578），并给出"伪自由"的另一层：被收买的内应反过来以"若不皈依就把父亲交给宗教裁判所"相逼（L181 "If he does not betray you to the Inquisition, _I will_."）——同谋即共缚。

entries.text: - **回溯式**：PG78605《THE TELEGRAM》里，伤害在读者眼前发生（Alice 与来访的 Everard 共度一夜），解释却由次日早晨才送达的错递电报揭开："Mr. Jenkyns unable to go to you to-night. Ill. Come if prefer."（L873-878）；随后由护士与马车夫的独立证词收拢（L944-1051、L1095-1132），Alice 自己的总结是"I did kiss a dead man!"（L1064）——揭示的全部材料都迟到，但每件都可回查。

entries.text: - **预言式（提前给解释）**：PG19337 反向操作——"If these shadows remain unaltered by the Future, the child will die."（L2057-2068）先把后果说破，悬念转移到"未来会不会变"；结尾 Tiny Tim 未死（L3443-3460），证明给出的是条件性未来而非定局。

entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG8694 的回撤不抹掉原始经历——女仆 Patty 确实看见"high, black figger... with a dead-white face"（L1444-1496），最后的解释是 Mrs. Snowdon 与 Jasper 在长廊议事（L2575-2594）：归属改了，"她当晚被吓晕"这件事实没被作废。PG10832 第二案的回撤同样保留了损失："blood-drip"被证明是从天花板缝隙滴下的染色水（L1447-1458），但两条被处死的猎犬仍然死了（L1000-1003、L1399-1416）——骗局是真的，伤亡也是真的。

entries.text: **F**：PG792 L1426-1428 的叙述者在确认声音无法归人后提出："That there are conscious beings, beside ourselves, in existence, whose modes of activity and information surpass our own, can scarcely be denied." 注意文本把它写成**她的推想**，并紧接其生理代价（L1431-1433 "An impulse was given to my spirits utterly incompatible with sleep"），没有把它变成作品已确认的世界法则。PG792 L549-554 还用脚注援引真实期刊病例（"A case, in its symptoms exactly parallel to this, is published in one of the Journals of Florence"）来支撑"看起来超自然其实可归类"的读法。

entries.text: **F**：PG22246 第一篇的结句是" That is how I saw a ghost--if it was a ghost. It was dead, anyhow."（L949-950）——既保留超自然读法，又给出最低限度的确定项（它死了）。PG23308 则在结尾只给指示物（L563 "Dancing madly on the end of a thread was a blood red feather."），让读者自己闭合因果链，不给心理描写。

entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG644 的叙述者在结尾对"鬼魂是否只是 Redlaw 的阴郁念头"拒绝裁决——"I say nothing."（L3854-3858），同时让厅中影子与不受影响的画像继续在场（L3860-3876）：双解被叙述者明文放弃裁决，而非含糊带过。PG78605《THE TELEGRAM》保留双解的方式是给两路人物各自按常理解释（护士归因电报延误，L1020-1046；车夫归因客人中途下车，L1122-1128），文本不替读者裁决。

entries.text: PG792 的对应程序是核验而非排除：搜查壁橱结果为全阴性（L1865-1866 "found every thing in its proper place and customary order"），再用声音编号（L1905-1906）与不可达空间（L1997-1998）排除人类来源。

entries.text: - PG10832 是"仪器化排除"最完整的样本：封条断裂而卡片完好、缎带一条未动（L226-245）；相机快门用细绳连到门把（L256-264）；麦克风测试完全收不到声音，排除机械装置（L1880-1899）；穿半身甲的假人触发机关，匕首"driven right through the thick breastplate"（L4958-4971）；最终破案靠照片对比——白天拍的门柱比夜里闪光拍的更粗（L5080-5086）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: - PG35587 展示排除程序通向"人的罪"：破蹄铁被猎刀撬下藏起、铁匠奉命拆鞋（L20014-20027）→ 蹄印匹配"the track o' a creetur--mayhap a murderer"（L20271）→ 致命弹上有"stamped crescent, and the letters C.C"（L25527）→ 作枪塞的焦边信纸读出人名（L25534-25563）。无头骑士的全部"灵异"目击最终收敛为一次误读的尸体搬运（R25）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: - 排查程序也可以被写成角色自我安慰的仪式：PG19337 里 Scrooge 逐屋检查"Nobody under the bed; nobody in the closet"再双重上锁（L554-586），而 Marley 依旧穿门而入——此时的排查显露的是角色的心态，不是作品的证据。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: **H**：这两部样本在角色企图确认超自然原因时展示具体的常规排除过程。**PG23172 L269-310 的官方程序反而压过目击证词，PG11438 则使环境破坏的原因保持开放**：因此“先穷尽机械解释”不是全部恐怖子类的普遍必要条件。若文本要得出强确定结论，证据负担应相应提高。

entries.text: - 若采用"专家拒绝参与"（PG22246 L703-704 "And, if they could, I would not be concerned in the explanation"），要写清他的职业理由，不能只写胆怯。

entries.text: **F**：PG8694 把"多数鬼故事是假的"写成结构性装置：圣诞守岁轮流讲鬼故事（L2262-2290），随后逐一证伪——Rose 的白衣女鬼是梦游的 Blanche（L2331-2382）、Annon 的"棺材"是椅背衣服、白卡片与手帕在月光下的错觉（L2393-2429）、Jasper 的闹鬼宅是口技艺人策划的私奔骗局（L2435-2488）、吓晕 Patty 的"鬼"是 Mrs. Snowdon 与 Jasper 在长廊议事（L2575-2594）。只有 Octavia 的巴黎女演员故事被保留为"不可解释"（L2505-2526）。正当读者被训练成"一切都有解释"时，钟敲十二下，真正的 Abbot's ghost 出现——黑袍、念珠、抬手指向 Sir Jasper（L2599-2651），且当晚应验为 Jasper 坠马濒死（L2774-2790），临终一句"Now, Father Abbot, lead on, I'll follow you."（L2854）与开篇家族诅咒闭环（L1530-1564）。

entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG11438 展示一条规则在书内被**两次验证**：瑞典人立规"不要命名、不要去想，思想会在他们的世界里留下痕迹"（L1602-1659），叙述者一次情绪失控（骂朋友"pagan"）立刻引来嗡鸣逼近（L1732-1774）——违规即触发；而疼痛昏迷让人"无法去想"，反而安全（L1810-1847）。规则的判据是内在的（想/不想），但后果外显（嗡鸣、凹坑），一致性可被读者复核。PG10832 则把"数字即规则的一部分"写明（L1081 "every number and measurement has a significance"）。

entries.text: **F**：两边都有。不可逆——PG23308 L317-318 "Nothing can be done once the feather has turned red"，且 Peter 已死于坠桥（L462-465）。可挽回——PG22246 第二篇的落水事故以救活收场（L1820-1844），Margaret 苏醒。PG22661 则两者并存：Clarimonde 化为灰烬不可逆（L1168-1171），而叙述者恢复了神职身份（L1176-1178）。

entries.text: **F**：PG23308 L514-516："His own breath must have released Peter from the hex. The last person's breath that touched the feather would feel the sting of the power." 施咒者因念咒时自己的气息也掠过羽毛，成为自己的受术者；他随即意识到" He was to be his own guinea pig"（L517-519），补救行动又被暴雨、泥泞与铁丝网延误（L529-541）。另一条相关证据：他把知识从书里取走并焚书（L197-198 "I have burned the book"），却无法烧掉自己的记忆（L209-210 "I could never forget it if I wanted to"）——**载体可毁，传承不终止**。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: **F**：PG22246 同卷的第二篇把第一篇的机制整个反转——月下面孔（L1182-1186）→ 火车站车窗里的同一张脸（L1301-1303）→ 使馆里真人出现（L1351-1369）→ 本人自述"我也以为见了鬼"（L1417-1421）。关键是可核对线索被提前埋好：她是邻居（L1425-1426 "She is your neighbour, since it _is_ you"）、当晚确实擅入庄园（L1487-1491 "we went out for a walk ... we trespassed"）、她走散后才撞见他。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: 对照 PG1668 的**确认**路径：画像与本人特征一致（L572-574 "there she is, in form and features, though Inferior in demoniac expression"），主人再补一条家族史（L581-582 "in yon fatal apartment incest and unnatural murder were committed"）。PG23379 的确认路径更硬：相册里的照片（L698-699）+ 死亡年限（L722-724 "the original of that picture has been dead for over fifteen years"）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: - PG35587 的"无头骑士"是全书被误读次数最多的"鬼"：真相是一次衣物交换的远期后果——Maurice 与 Henry 互换帽与氅（L24139 "I gave Henry Poindexter my Mexican sombrero and striped blanket--taking his cloth cloak and Panama hat"），Henry 被杀后尸身被缚于马背、断首悬于鞍角，于是所有目击者（Phelim L11437、四名假扮的 Comanche L11748、搜索队、Zeb 本人）看见的都是同一具"无头"的尸骑；Maurice 自己认领时说"They were my own. But for the exchange we had made, I might have fancied it was myself. It was Henry Poindexter"（L24740）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: - PG8694 的女仆目击同样为真：她确实看见黑影、确实吓晕（L1444-1496），错的只是归属——那是两个活人在长廊议事（L2575-2594）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: - PG8377《A Quicksilver Cassandra》的"预知镜"是仪器误读：镜中"未来场景"其实只是镜像左右颠倒，Marian 一句提醒后头痛消失、两人和好（L2619-2638）——回撤针对的是读法，不是"他确实在镜中看到了那个画面"。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: **H**：判断"鬼 / 活人 / 已故者"的 V 级证据链有三类——**肖像或照片比对**、**时间与地点可核对**、**已故年限等档案事实**。缺任何一类时，文本就保持未定。新补证（PG35587）补出第四类：**随身物件归属**（帽子、斗篷、马的归谁）——衣物交换这类提前埋设的物件线索，可以一次性解释此后所有"灵异"目击。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: - 用"物件归属"作线索时，交换/遗失要发生在目击**之前**（PG35587 的交换在 L24139、目击从 L10571 起陆续出现），揭晓时让当事人自己认领（L24740），不要靠旁白代认。

Yours!"（L10003），但文本以冷漠口吻收束：她因怀孕被法网宽恕，Ensor 只留下一句祈祷便离英（L9601-10146 块）——恐怖落在"恶行无报"而不是"报应"。另有**延续型**：PG4046 的结尾是邀请而非安息——"the Garden of Eternity is yours for ever--now"（L2204），超自然一方从未退场，也从不现身。

entries.text: 对照 PG22661 的处置是**改变认知**：Sérapion 主张掘墓（L1106-1110 "It is necessary that we shall disinter her remains, and that you shall behold in how pitiable a state the object of your love is"），并用圣水使尸体化灰（L1168-1171）。PG23379 的处置则是**替换**：医生开出"非正统处方"用真狗替换鬼带来的狗（L465-467 "I'm going to prescribe something very unusual, nurse. Tomorrow night a covered basket will be delivered here for you"）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: - **利用实体自设约束的"反制封存"**：PG8377《The Water Ghost of Harrowby Hall》的鬼自带规则（圣诞夜十二点出现、滞留一小时、所触皆湿，L94-124），继承人不在陆地上防她，而是把她引到冰点以下的湖面拖延到她自我冻结，最终"ghost of Harrowby Hall, conquered by the cold, a prisoner for all time."（L429）——处置用的每一步材料都来自实体早已声明的约束。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: - **第三方代偿式解除**：PG644 的礼物不可由当事人撤销（L2822-2838），最终由交易范围外的 Milly 间接化解，记忆"through the teaching of pure love"被归还（L3793-3796）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: - PG11438 补充"不处置"的生存位：两人最终的"解法"是不去看、不去想（L1710-1725），一次昏迷替他们完成了这件事（L1810-1847）——活下来不等于解决，威胁在结尾原样留在那里。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **⚠️ 新证据张力（2026-10-31 补齐 run）**：本条旧"反例自查"称"本批 V 级样本不支持'主角用某种方法消灭了它'的结局"。新台账补入了反例：PG8377 的水鬼确实被**永久制伏**（L429 "conquered by the cold, a prisoner for all time"），PG644 的诅咒确实被**完整解除**（L3793-3796）。双方证据并存的关系是：能被制伏/解除的实体，其可制伏性都来自**事前已写明的约束或交易条款**（湿与冷；"礼物不可撤但可由他人代偿"），而非主角临时找到的弱点；且 PG8377 属喜剧语域（本 Skill 负触发之一）。据此，"消灭式结局"不是非法，但必须由前文约束兑现，不得临场发明——原文的反例自查按此理解收窄适用。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23379 的超自然事件结束后，文本记的是**活人关系的改变**：父亲当场宣布" The dog stays."（L736-737），并在楼梯口与妻子正面对峙；医生的总结是"she is well scared, thank God. I hardly think she will interfere much in future with young Frank. And by the looks of him, the boy's father has had his backbone stiffened"（L796-799）。鬼的最后状态不是安息，而是"仍在画中且知情"（L810-811 "the admonitory, inscrutable, but very gratified pictured eyes of old Mr. Wiley"）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: 对照 PG1668 L587-591：两位朋友" parted in a very different mood"，一人去封门、一人离开——改变的是友谊与后续人生。PG8492 的收尾同样落在人物状态上（L8769-8771 镜中自视后"his clouded mind and his clouded thoughts grew clearer"，L8790 "Through this he passed with his rose."）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **F**（2026-10-31 台账补齐 run 补证）：PG19337 的结算全在活人身上——Scrooge 宣布"I am about to raise your salary!"（L3399-3439 段内），并待 Tiny Tim"as a second father"（L3443-3460，Tiny Tim 未死）；超自然一方此后再无交往（"He had no further intercourse with Spirits"）。PG8694 的收束是"三场婚礼同日举行"且"never again was the north gallery haunted by the ghostly Abbot"（L2859-2866）——幽灵的谢幕与活人的重新配对写在同一段。PG644 的结算包括 Redlaw 当众誓言保护那个野孩子、并设圣诞宴（L3811-3824）。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **H**：V 级样本普遍把"结算"放在活人的关系、地位与自我认知上；超自然一方往往只是维持原状或退场。新补证显示结算可以与"威胁存续"并存（PG11438 的两人活着回家，柳林未变），也可以与"幽灵谢幕"同段完成（PG8694）。

entries.text: - 同一位调查者、同一套排查程序，得出三种归属：人为（案二）、人为加未解释残余（案四）、真显现（案三 L2008-2048 巨唇、案五 L3484-3508 穿墙孩童）。**程序相同不保证归属唯一**；官方/验尸式结论（heart spasm 之于第四案）与 PG23172 的"山狮"判决同型，都是"程序给出一个可写下的词"而非"剩余矛盾已被解释"。

entries.text: - PG23172 的“程序裁决”不是全知者真相；PG11438 的“环境损坏”不必强行对应一名有形凶手；PG19337 的幽灵戏剧可以以人的转变为结算，而不披露灵界操作规则；PG10832 允许同一程序产出三种归属；PG78605 允许多份常理解释并存而不收敛。

entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L18–98 的验尸现场由验尸官手持 Morgan 私人日记、Harker 记者以宣誓口供陈述；PG19337 L146–178 的 Scrooge 传言由全知叙述者主动核实 Marley 死亡。两者的证据渠道不同。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L69–96 的 Harker 急于捍卫被认作虚构的所见，还宣称愿宣誓为真；PG11438 L676–750 的叙述者先用主观错觉为超自然感觉辩护，后来反而恐惧加深。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/01-frames-and-witnesses.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L145–240 是 Harker 目击的移动草茎与攻击；L245–313 有验尸员目视身体创伤；L317–398 才是死者日记对不可见颜色的解释假说。陪审团另判美洲狮，不等于已证实。

entries.text: **F**：PG11438 L676–750 叙述者说“看见”非人形体却自疑；PG19337 L3081–3169 未来精灵不回答 Scrooge 的 `Will/May`，人物对最终未来仍有未知。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L145–240 中草被压低、Harker 受重物撞、Morgan 身体受攻击构成*不可见施害者的可见后果*；PG11438 L770–999 在见过非人形后才发现独木舟与桨的物理损坏。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L180–240 的悬疑由高草方向变化、枪声、看不到的撞击交叉出现；PG11438 L676–750 先见到异常影像，L770–999 续以触碰帐篷的重量和物件变化。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L201–240 Harker 在看不见的撞击后倒地、努力起身并奔向同伴；PG11438 L676–750 两名旅客的震惊、自辩、退缩分阶段发生。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/02-dread-staging.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L123–131 在验尸死亡现场，陪审员竟因“看小说”的刻薄回答短暂发笑；下一段又恢复审问与恐惧。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L145–240 行动中不解释怪物外形，L317–398 直到证人离开后才引日记猜想“人眼看不见的颜色”，此时死者无法再与读者核对。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L269–313 的陪审员正式将死因判为美洲狮，L317–398 又出现不支持该判决的旧日记和星光遮蔽线索。权威回撤并没有完成最终证实。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: **F**：PG11438 L1001–1500 的瑞典旅伴从物理损伤推想非人类存在；PG23172 L360–391 的 Morgan 从不可闻声音类比“不可见颜色”仍只是一种角色理论。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/03-revelation-positions.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 末尾将验尸判决与日记假说并置，未由叙述者确认哪个属于真实世界机制；PG19337 L3120–3169 则允许人物把未来影像解释成可改变的可能性。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: **F**：PG19337 L3081–3169 的未来精灵只指方向不回答，主角自己提出 `Will/May` 的命运规则；PG23172 L317–391 日记主人提出怪物因颜色不可见的假设。**两者均非可验的客观法则**。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: **F**：PG19337 L3120–3460 的 Scrooge 因可能的未来恐惧改掉旧行为，Tiny Tim 在正式结局没有死；反驳“恐怖结局的灾难不可逆”。PG23172 L245–313 则确有 Morgan 死亡且无恢复。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/04-rules-and-rituals.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L317–398 的日记是解释线索，非客观有效的诅咒媒介；PG19337 L3120–3134 的墓碑是未来象征。**H**：物件可承载信息而不必自动带魔法。**P**：标记“承载信息/被人物相信有力/作品已设真实魔力”，没有第三类证据就不写强制仪式规则。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L317–398 对“不可见颜色”的超自然假说保留证据缺口；PG19337 L3120–3460 则用 Scrooge 真实改变使未来恐惧闭合。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 L245–313 的验尸现场陪审员不尊重 Harker 证词，文本让读者看见旁人轻佻与真正身体伤害的对比；PG19337 L3001–3080 未来影像让 Cratchit 一家持续悼念 Tiny Tim。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **F**：PG19337 L3120–3184 三位圣诞精灵用过去/现在/未来影像使 Scrooge 回看人生，主角最终改变；但**没有证据支持**“善意幽灵必须借坏人达成复仇”。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-03/rounds/round-p4-wave4-agent3-final-2026-10-30/output/horror-dread-and-revelation/references/05-endings-and-ethics.md
entries.text: **F**：PG23172 以 Morgan 的理论而非法律结案收尾，作者并未给出明确道德说教；PG19337 的结尾则公开倡导同情与慈善行动。两种都存在。

entries.text: PG30729 批评部分、Machen 两书、PG14099 构成本批四个非虚构源。作者不同、形态不同（文学批评 / 诗学自传 / 证言汇编），**来源族去重时不合并**；但共享硬约束：**不得单独支撑任何 CORE 规则**。

entries.text: **唯一放宽**：PG30729 批评部分的论述对象是已出版的虚构作品（雨果的小说），其"恐怖如何被制造"具有跨作品观察性质，可信度略高于纯自述。**A7 与 L1 两条**允许"1 个非虚构源 + 1 个小说源"即构成 COND。此放宽不适用于其他规则。

entries.text: 1. **兑现轴 V**：V0 从未具象出现；V1 出现一个可见实体；V2 错兑现（等待 A、揭示 B）。问用户“这篇恐怖来自等待、直面，还是预期落空”，**不以长短篇直接禁止 V2**。PG11074 L3131–3132 在文本中讨论 `Nothing happened` 的原因；PG932 L776–780 以实体与宅体变化兑现；PG30729 L9389–9393 揭示熟悉的死者而非预期对象。三者是对照故事 F，不是效果排行。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-04/rounds/round-p4-agent-a-2026-10-30/output/horror-thriller-craft-b04/references/rework-decision.md
entries.text: 2. **解释轴 E**：E0 留白；E1 解释风险机制但保留一项悬念；E2 全解释。PG175 的舞台机械与身份谜为强解释的作品范例，PG9964 L12–14 用知识不可达制造敬畏（不等于特定怪物已被证实）。**“90%”仅比喻，不是数学阈值**；为悬念强留 10% 会破坏已经承诺的侦探式收束。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-04/rounds/round-p4-agent-a-2026-10-30/output/horror-thriller-craft-b04/references/rework-decision.md
entries.text: 3. **余数轴 R**：R1 可触的物证/异物，R2 叙述者信念或记忆，R3 社会制度仍照常运作，R0 无余数。PG1289 L36–40 故意把日间正常环境与鬼屋预期倒置；PG35153 L446–449 是作者回忆的诗学意图而非成品；二者不能证明“余数只能物证”。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-04/rounds/round-p4-agent-a-2026-10-30/output/horror-thriller-craft-b04/references/rework-decision.md
entries.text: - **L1 小说**：`PG30729 L8646–9396` 是《The Body-Snatcher》，可观察共犯、医学职业信誉、错尸/叙述空白；只计一个小说来源族。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-04/rounds/round-p4-agent-a-2026-10-30/output/horror-thriller-craft-b04/references/rework-decision.md
entries.text: - **L2 非虚构**：`PG30729 L1–8640` 为人物与历史评论，L4893 的“fugitives captured”不是恐怖小说情节；只能作为写作启发或历史批评论述，不等同虚构恐怖的跨书验证。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-04/rounds/round-p4-agent-a-2026-10-30/output/horror-thriller-craft-b04/references/rework-decision.md
entries.text: - **同作者/非虚构**：PG35153、PG78106 是同作者自传与创作意见，只计一个独立思想族；PG14099 鬼故事集与导言要分层；PG17893 的类型评论不可当成全体作品的类型定义。

entries.source_file: distill/分类蒸馏/16-类型小说专项/03-恐怖惊悚怪谈/批次-04/rounds/round-p4-agent-a-2026-10-30/output/horror-thriller-craft-b04/references/rework-decision.md
entries.text: - **控制反例**：PG13314 感伤、PG269 讽刺、PG9964 敬畏、PG9468 混合体裁、PG6761 流浪汉及 PG30729 非虚构部分不作为独立“恐怖规则核心票”。它们的价值是揭示：恐惧可以由弱解释、反讽或伦理后果产生，拒绝一体通用。
